structured_output.what_is_happening: "Elon Mask" is a parody meme coin launched on pump.fun at about 07:19 UTC. It left the bonding curve in about 2 minutes, which means very fast, coordinated early buying. It did about $490k of volume in its first 12 minutes on PumpSwap, peaked near $109k market cap and is now around $75k, down 23% over the last 5 minutes. It has a thin mystery-themed website ("Probably Elon. Identity unconfirmed") and an X handle, @elonmasksollla. Search engines show no organic discussion. Many older "elon mask" tokens already exist.
